our_interpretation: The plain reading is recurring failure to attach labels to the correct object parts, not an inability to produce any correct diagram.

Label placement and identification must be assessed separately from spelling and image quality. No numerical reliability threshold is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: Dated records of the November 2024 system show repeated incorrect associations between labels and object parts across relevant attempts or tasks.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable evaluations of that system show consistently correct label-to-part associations, with the reported failures established as exceptional or incorrectly scored.
